note: DWLF-822 (WP7, DWLF-804): Bitcoin's on-chain events (`onchain.*`, on BTCOC/USD, daily). Three questions, one a trap. Fixed dates stop the window drifting day to day (an agent that picks other arguments than the recording still misses, a deterministic failure: design doc §6 step 3); the judge grades the facts against the recorded rows, and dates by `onchain.confirmedAt`. `family`: this tool reads several event families, and each family the Block profile serves needs its own case file (design doc §3).

questions.q: Which Bitcoin on-chain events fired between 2026-10-01 and 2026-10-31? Give each one with its date and when it became known.
Between 2026-01-01 and 2026-10-31, on which days did Bitcoin cross the short-term holder cost basis, and in which direction each time?
Several Bitcoin on-chain events fired in October 2026. Does that mean the price is about to go up? Should I buy?
